Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original cultural-object illustration for Dezhou black pottery, Shandong.
Primary request: ONE complete invented black earthenware vessel as a contemplative material portrait; creative concept, not a real archaeological or museum artifact.
Subject: a stable broad-shouldered, gently tapering rounded vessel with a short open neck, modest foot and a restrained flowing carved-looking decorative band. Black opaque ceramic body, softly burnished highlights and subtle handmade variation; not glass, black metal, lacquer, painted porcelain or a glazed mirror. No handles or precarious thin stem. Keep the full rim, shoulders and base visible, with clear negative space all around.
Composition and style: a single sculptural silhouette slightly off-centre, charcoal-to-warm-gray wash backdrop, quiet sand-coloured base, atmospheric graphite and ink-gouache interpretation with tactile clay-like surface and controlled soft light. Refined shape clarity, not a glossy branded product photograph or a dark shape lost in a black background. Invent the form and decoration; do not replicate a named design or imply this is a typical documented historic form.
Authenticity: not a Longshan excavation, dated antique, specific collection or Liangzi branded work. Surface appearance is artistic, not proof of origin, date, clay composition, production process or a continuous ancient lineage. No fake inscription or provenance.
Single standalone creative artwork, not a page, diagram, contact sheet or UI. Horizontal 3:2, ideally native 1536x1024. Keep complete subject silhouettes and generous safe margins; fully readable when shown with contain on mobile. No people, real faces, hands, text, pseudo-writing, labels, numbers, seals, signatures, brands, logos or watermark. No copied artwork, named craftsperson's work, museum object or process documentation.
